Subject: Internship Offer Letter Dear {name},

We are pleased to offer you {Mr_Ms}. {name}. An internship opportunity at Shine Craft Technologies for the duration of {duration}. This internship program is designed to provide practical industry exposure, technical training, project experience, and professional development opportunities through participation in real-time projects, guided assignments, learning activities, and operational workflows. While contributing to the ongoing Projects/Product at Shine Craft Technologies.


1.  Internship Details

·       Internship Domain: {domain}

·       Internship Category: Pro / Beginner / Learner

·       Internship Duration: {duration}

·       Internship Start Date: {start_date}

·       Internship End Date: {end_date}

·       Work Mode: Work From Office / Hybrid / Remote

·       Reporting Mentor/Lead: {mentor_lead)

·       Stipend (if applicable): {stipend}

The internship category, responsibilities, stipend eligibility, project allocation, and operational access shall be determined based on:

·       Technical Evaluation,

·       Interview Performance,

·       Project/Task Assessment,

·       Learning Capability,

·       Operational Requirements,

·       Company Discretion.

2.  Internship Selection Process Acknowledgement

The intern acknowledges that the internship opportunity may involve:

·       Internship application screening,

·       Technical evaluation,

·       Non-technical evaluation,

·       Project/problem statement assessment,

·       Practical task evaluation,

·       Communication assessment,

·       Performance-based categorization.

Selection and classification shall remain subject to company evaluation and operational requirements.

3.  Nature of Internship

This internship is intended primarily for:

o   Educational learning,

o   Practical exposure,

o   Skill development,

o   Industry training,

o   Project experience,

o   Professional mentoring. Unless specifically stated in writing:

o   This internship shall not constitute permanent employment,

o   Completion of internship does not guarantee job placement,

Stipend/payment eligibility may vary based on internship category and Company discretion.

4.  Working Schedule & Participation Expectations

As part of the internship program conducted under institutional/academic coordination where applicable, interns are expected to actively participate in:

o   Assigned work,

o   Project activities,

o   Technical training,

o   Meetings,

o   Reporting activities,

o   Project discussions,

o   Review sessions,

o   Learning tasks

During scheduled internship hours.

Interns may occasionally be required to contribute additional effort based on:

o   Project Deadlines,

o   Milestone Completion,

o   Operational Requirements,

o   Collaborative Activities,

o   Learning Objectives.

Interns are expected to maintain professional commitment and communication throughout the internship period. If an intern wishes to discontinue the internship,

They shall inform the Company in advance and complete any reasonable reporting, handover, or exit formalities as applicable.

Repeated unresponsiveness, sudden abandonment of assigned responsibilities, or prolonged non-communication after onboarding/project allocation may impact internship continuation, certification eligibility, institutional reporting, and future opportunities with the Company.

5.  Work Mode & Reporting Requirements

Depending on project or operational requirements, the internship may be conducted

through:

·       Work From Office (WFO),

·       Hybrid mode,

·       Remote/Work From Home mode. Interns shall:

·       Maintain regular communication,

·       Attend scheduled meetings,

·       Respond to mentor/team communications,

·       Submit assigned reports and updates,

Maintain professionalism during official activities.

6.  Mentorship & Guidance

The intern shall be guided by assigned mentors, technical leads, managers, or authorized Company representatives during the internship period.

The Company may:

·       Allocate mentors,

·       Change reporting structures,

·       Modify project assignments,

·       Revise training activities

Based on operational requirements.

7.  Daily Work Reports & Progress Tracking

The intern shall maintain and submit:

o   Daily work reports,

o   Task updates,

o   Progress summaries,

o   Learning/activity records,

o   Project status updates

Through platforms or formats prescribed by the Company. Failure to maintain required reporting standards may impact:

o   Evaluation,

o   Internship continuation,

o   Certification eligibility,

o   Performance grading.

 

8.  Performance Monitoring & Evaluation

The Company may conduct:

o   Periodic evaluations,

o   Mentor reviews,

o   Technical assessments,

o   Project reviews,

o   Attendance reviews,

o   Communication evaluations,

o   Operational performance assessments. Evaluation may consider:

o   Consistency,

o   Learning capability,

o   Technical contribution,

o   Reporting discipline,

o   Collaboration,

o   Professionalism,

o   Task completion.

9.  Source Code, Repository & Documentation Responsibilities

Where applicable, interns shall:

·       Maintain assigned repositories,

·       Push regular commits,

·       Follow version control practices,

All:

·       Maintain documentation,

·       Update project records,

·       Follow Company coding and repository standards.

o   Repositories,

o   Source code,

o   Scripts,

o   Apis,

o   Databases,

o   Project files,

o   Technical documents,

o   Deliverables

Shall remain the exclusive intellectual property of Shine Craft Technologies.

10.  Confidentiality & Data Protection

Interns may receive access to:

o   Source code,

o   Credentials,

o   Repositories,

o   Apis,

o   Databases,

o   Client information,

o   Internal documents,

o   Technical systems.

The intern shall:

o   Maintain strict confidentiality,

o   Avoid unauthorized disclosure,

o   Protect Company/client information,

o   Comply with Company security requirements.

Confidentiality obligations shall continue even after internship completion.

11.  Use of Company Resources & Materials

The intern shall:

o   Responsibly use Company systems and resources,

o   Protect Company assets,

o   Avoid misuse or unauthorized sharing,

o   Comply with IT & cybersecurity policies.

Any intentional misuse, loss, unauthorized access, or negligent handling of Company resources may result in:

o   Restriction of access,

o   Disciplinary action,

o   Recovery proceedings where applicable,

o   Discontinuation of internship.

  1. Knowledge Transfer & HandoverRequirements

Before completion of the internship, the intern may be required to:

·       Complete project handover,

·       Submit documentation,

·       Transfer project knowledge,

·       Provide deployment/setup details,

·       Share authorized credentials/access details created during project execution,

·       Assist in operational transition where required.

Failure to complete required handover formalities may impact internship completion status or certification eligibility.

13.  Final Presentation & Exit Formalities

The intern may be required to:

o   Present project work,

o   Demonstrate completed tasks,

o   Submit final reports,

o   Complete feedback forms,

o   Participate in evaluation discussions,

o   Complete exit clearance procedures.

Internship certificates or completion acknowledgements may remain subject to:

o   Satisfactory performance,

o   Reporting compliance,

o   Handover completion,

o   Asset clearance,

o   Policy compliance.

14.  Internship Discontinuation

The Company reserves the right to:

·       Discontinue the internship,

·       Suspend access,

·       Modify responsibilities,

·       Terminate internship participation In cases including but not limited to:

o   Misconduct,

o   Confidentiality breach,

o   Repeated absence,

o   Policy violations,

o   Operational concerns,

o   Non-performance,

o   Unauthorized activities.

The Company reserves the right to restrict future internship, training, freelance, employment, certification, recommendation, or collaboration opportunities for candidates who repeatedly violate internship expectations, abandon assigned responsibilities, fail to complete required reporting/handover obligations, or engage in serious policy violations.

15.  Institutional Coordination & Academic Reporting

Where the internship is conducted through institutional coordination, academic partnership, industrial training, or On-Duty (OD) arrangements, the Company may communicate attendance status, participation records, performance feedback,

Discontinuation status, misconduct concerns, or operational observations to the respective educational institution where operationally or academically required.

16.  No Employment Guarantee

Completion of the internship shall not automatically guarantee:

o   Employment,

o   Stipend conversion,

o   Placement,

o   Future engagement,

o   Permanent role allocation.

Any future employment opportunity shall remain subject to separate evaluation and Company discretion.

17.  Acceptance

Please sign and return a copy of this letter as confirmation of your acceptance of the

internship terms and conditions.

We welcome you to Shine Craft Technologies and wish you a productive and valuable

learning experience.

For Shine Craft Technologies

Authorized Signatory

Ajith Kumar V Founder and COO
